summary: Build a Smart Queue & Feedback Management System as a pure client-side web app (HTML/CSS/JS) using browser localStorage for persistence: token generation, live queue display, staff controls (next customer call + service completion), and feedback (rating + comments).
architectural_notes: Use browser localStorage as the source of truth for queue entries (tokens/status) and feedback entries; no backend database/APIs.

existing_features.title: Build a user-facing frontend that lets users: (1) select a service, (2) join the queue, (3) view live-refreshed queue status (position + status), and (4) leave the queue.
Build a user-facing feedback UI: users can select a service, submit a rating and optional comment, and see a confirmation/receipt state after successful submission.
Add an admin/staff frontend area to manage queues and review feedback: choose a service, view current queue entries, advance/serve next, mark no-show/cancel, clear queue, and view feedback list.
Apply a cohesive, creative visual theme across the frontend (colors, typography, spacing, and components) suitable for a “service queue” product, avoiding blue/purple as primary brand colors.
Add required static generated images to the frontend and render them in the UI (store under frontend/public/assets/generated).
Add a frontend-only “Local Storage Mode” that persists queue data and feedback data in browser localStorage, so the app can run without depending on backend canister APIs for these functions.

Implement token generation for queue entries in Local Storage Mode: each service queue entry receives a human-friendly token number that increments per service and is displayed consistently across user and staff/admin views.

Add a live queue display experience in Local Storage Mode that mirrors the current canister-backed behavior: users can see their position/status update automatically and staff can see the current queue list update automatically.

In Local Storage Mode, add staff controls for “Next customer call” and “Service completion” aligned to the existing admin workflow, ensuring the next waiting token can be called and then marked completed/served.
Persist feedback submissions (rating + optional comment) in localStorage in Local Storage Mode, and make them reviewable from the Admin/Staff feedback list UI for the selected service.
Add developer-facing documentation explaining Local Storage Mode, including the localStorage schema/keys, how tokens are generated, and how to manually reset local data for testing.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement smart digital queuing (join queue and track position/status)
Implement feedback management (collect and submit feedback for services)
Implement localStorage-based persistence for queue data and feedback (no backend/APIs)
